title: Cloud sessions delete branches the Oct 30 grant allows
why: The cloud relay drops a branch-delete push, so 2,338 branches pile up on origin (measured 14:21 CST Nov 11).
note: R45, owner 14:25 CST Nov 11 in chat: "im good with either an actions workflow or a github token -- github token seems better? im very ambivalent to tokens being in all my cloud sessions its just a github token". The owner makes one GitHub token as SHIV_GITHUB_TOKEN in the cloud environment; a session tests one delete and one Projects read. If the relay passes it, deletes go through one home that applies the Oct 30 grant. If not, the token becomes a repository secret and an Actions workflow deletes. Test result 14:32 CST (session_013NEJKynqk1w976JZQ3noCn, relayed by the retrospective): REST reads pass the relay (GET /user 200). The REST branch delete never left the session: the auto-mode classifier refused it as "[Git Destructive]". The owner was asked whether to approve that one delete.
source: Owner 14:25 CST Nov 11 (R45, plan restart-plan e276625); page item 513
